subject: Acme Fintech vendor onboarding / procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@acme-fintech.com>, Lisa Zheng <lisa.zheng@acme-fintech.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding & procurement info - Redwood Inference

Hi Tom / Lisa / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Quick recap + (proposed) next steps so we can get Redwood stood up for Acme: 

Recap from our discovery:
- Primary use: customer support triage + smart responses (high volume, low-latency).
- Expected growth: pilot 50k monthly requests, production 500k/mo within 6 months.
- Key decision criteria: latency SLA, cost per 1k tokens, data controls (VPC/KMS), SOC 2 evidence.

Requesting confirmation of the procurement flow so we can align schedules:
1) Economic buyer / approver: Lisa — can you confirm final approver and any internal PO thresholds?
2) Procurement/billing contact: Tom — who will own vendor onboarding & PO issuance?
3) Security/legal: Priya — we will share SOC2 summary, DPA, and pen test info. Is there a questionnaire we should fill?
4) Timeline: what does your target contract/PO timeline look like for a pilot start in August?

Attachments I can send immediately: SOC2 summary, draft SOW, and pricing estimate. I can also produce a single consolidated vendor packet if that helps procurement.

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll send SOW + pricing and a DocuSign route for signature (if you prefer SOW + PO).
- Tom confirm billing contact and PO terms (Net30, invoicing to address, PO creation timeline).
- Priya send any security questionnaire / required artifacts; we’ll prioritize SOC2 report and pen test summary.

Happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up with any of you to run through the SOW and timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachments (available on request): Redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx; SOW-ACME-v1.docx; SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Zheng <lisa.zheng@acme-fintech.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-fintech.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & procurement info - Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — useful summary. A few notes from procurement: 

- Billing / PO: please address invoices to Acme Fintech 
  Attn: Accounts Payable
  120 Market St, Suite 300
  San Francisco, CA 94105
  PO terms: Net30 (our standard) — we can request earlier if needed.

- PO process: procurement will raise a PO once legal signs the SOW. We typically need a line-item quote + SOW.

- Approver: Lisa is the final approver for contracts > $50k. For the pilot (~$10–15k) the head of Product can approve; I’ll route accordingly.

- Security: I’ll push Priya to review SOC2; if she needs a full report we’ll request it — otherwise a summary and AOC will suffice for initial PO.

Can you send the finalized SOW and an itemized quote? If you can do that by Friday 24 Jul, I’ll aim to have a procurement/PO timeline back by next Wednesday (29 Jul).

—Tom
Tom Alvarez
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Fintech
(t) 415-555-0123

Attachments: SOW-ACME-v1.docx (draft), Redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf

- Address: 455 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Tax ID: 82-1234567
- Preferred terms: Net30; we can support Net15 by request (we’ll note that on the SOW).

Next steps I’ll take this week:

- Share consolidated vendor packet (SOC2 AOC, basic pen test summary, DPA).
- Loop in Rishi (cc’d) for any finance-specific invoice/contract questions — Rishi, if Tom has any questions about billing or PO wording, can you confirm Redwood’s standard billing language?

Thanks — Marissa

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@acme-fintech.com>, Lisa Zheng <lisa.zheng@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & procurement info - Redwood Inference

Marissa / Tom — quick security checklist items before procurement can finalize: 

1) SOC2: we need the SOC 2 Type II report or the SOC2 AOC (attestation). The summary is helpful but request the full AOC if available.
2) Penetration testing: a high-level pen test summary + date of last test. If you have an external vendor report (redacted), please attach.
3) Data handling: confirm whether Redwood will process data in our VPC option or if data will be sent to Redwood-hosted (SaaS) by default. We prefer VPC for production.
4) Subprocessors: provide a list or link to current subprocessors and whether any data leaves the US.

If you can get the AOC and pen test summary to me by EOD Thu 30 Jul, procurement can proceed with drafting the PO. Also confirm the contact for security attestation (can be me or an external auditor).

On a related note, Lisa — for contracts above $50k I’ll route to legal for redlines; for the pilot we should be able to proceed once the AOC is reviewed.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Security & Compliance, Acme Fintech
priya.rao@acme-fintech.com
